scope: Original five-sensor B1 simulation replay into the actual native LIVO state; independent evaluator only receives truth. Not an AP4.7.1 flight or hardware result.
pixel_noise_status: declared engineering covariance, not calibrated pixel uncertainty
range_noise_origin: B1 frozen Gaussian simulator noise, not hardware ToF calibration
hypothesis: Compare actual raw two-view updates with the same native reset and auxiliary-state handling; report trajectory accuracy, update availability, covariance diagnostics and all failures without requiring full to win every comparison.
limitations: Fixed native map and independent native measurement approximation; historical map correlation is not restored.
Only exact acquisition-stamp range seeds are consumed; the remaining 50 Hz range samples are received and audited without being fused in this profile.
The original native baseline does not apply the new SO(3) reset; paired flow claims use joint_no_flow.
Single existing flight input is an integration experiment, not a multiseed degradation evaluation or publication-level superiority claim.
